title: BSSw blog post front matter
description: YAML front matter for _posts/YYYY-MM-DD-<slug>.md and _drafts/<slug>.md. Topic, track and author values are slugs; vocabularies are served at /api/taxonomy.json and /api/authors.json.

slug.description: URL slug: /blog_posts/<slug>. Defaults to the parameterized title.

date.description: Publication date (YYYY-MM-DD). Drafts may omit it.

deck.description: One-paragraph summary (Markdown inline). Shown under the title, in listings, and in social cards.

topics.description: Topic slugs from /api/taxonomy.json (categories[].topics[].slug). Order is display order.

hero_image.description: Optional hero image under /images/. When set, the deck moves into the body.

rss_date.description: Re-surface the post in the RSS feed on this date.

published.description: false hides a post in _posts without deleting it.

legacy_path.description: Source path in the legacy content repo (set by scripts/import_legacy.rb).
